query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Migrate Vercel projects and GitHub repositories between connected accounts, preserve domains and settings, add deployment workflows, trigger/verify deployments, and audit repository access.
query_ground_truth.intent: Preserve and reassign custom domains from an old Vercel project to the migrated one.

requirement_groups.purpose: Retrieve domains attached to a Vercel project
List domains from Vercel to check ownership and details

results.execution_guidance: Found 7 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Vercel is a platform for frontend frameworks and static sites, enabling developers to host websites and web services that deploy instantly, scale automatically, and require minimal configuration.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=vercel. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="vercel") to create a connection BEFORE executing any vercel tools.

VERCEL_MOVE_PROJECT_DOMAIN.description: Tool to move a domain from one Vercel project to another. Use when you need to transfer domain ownership between projects.

slug.description: Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

domain.description: The project domain name to move (e.g., 'www.example.com')

teamId.description: Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or project name of the source project

redirect.description: Target destination domain for redirection. When set, requests to this domain will redirect to the specified target domain.

gitBranch.description: Git branch to associate with this domain in the target project. When set, deployments from this branch will be accessible via this domain. Maximum 250 characters.

projectId.description: The unique identifier of the target project to move the domain to

redirectStatusCode.description: HTTP status code for redirect. 301: Permanent redirect (cached by browsers), 302: Temporary redirect, 307: Temporary redirect (preserves method), 308: Permanent redirect (preserves method).

VERCEL_TRANSFER_IN_DOMAIN.description: Tool to transfer a domain to Vercel from another registrar. Use when you need to migrate domain registration to Vercel. Before transferring, obtain the authorization code from the current registrar and verify the domain is unlocked and eligible for transfer.

years.description: Number of years to renew the domain for after transfer. Must be valid for the TLD.

domain.description: The domain name to transfer in (e.g., 'example.com')

teamId.description: Team ID to perform the transfer on behalf of

authCode.description: Authorization code for the domain transfer. Obtain this code from the current (losing) registrar.

autoRenew.description: Whether the domain should automatically renew before expiration. Can be changed later via the Vercel Dashboard or API.

expectedPrice.description: Expected transfer price in USD. Use this to prevent unexpected charges if the price changes between checking and transferring.

zip.description: Postal or ZIP code. Must be a non-empty string without leading/trailing whitespace.

city.description: City name. Must be a non-empty string without leading/trailing whitespace.

email.description: Valid RFC 5322 email address for domain registration

phone.description: Valid E.164 phone number (e.g., +1.5551234567). Must start with + followed by country code and 8-15 total digits.

state.description: State or province. Must be a non-empty string without leading/trailing whitespace.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (two uppercase letters)

address1.description: Primary street address. Must be a non-empty string without leading/trailing whitespace.

lastName.description: Last name of the domain registrant. Must be a non-empty string without leading/trailing whitespace.

firstName.description: First name of the domain registrant. Must be a non-empty string without leading/trailing whitespace.

contactInformation.description: Contact information for domain registration. All fields except address2, company_name, and fax are required.

VERCEL_CREATE_OR_TRANSFER_DOMAIN.description: Tool to add an existing domain to the Vercel platform. Use when you need to add a domain to Vercel for DNS management or transfer a domain. Supports two methods: 'add' for adding existing domains and 'move-in' for transferring domains (requires authorization token).

name.description: The domain name to add or transfer (e.g., 'example.com')

slug.description: Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

zone.description: Whether to create a DNS zone for the domain. Only applicable when method is 'add'.

token.description: Authorization token required when method is 'move-in' for domain transfer. Not used for 'add' method.

method.description: The domain operation to perform. Use 'add' to add an existing domain or 'move-in' to transfer a domain. When using 'move-in', the 'token' field is required. If not specified, defaults to 'add'.

teamId.description: Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

cdnEnabled.description: Whether to enable CDN for the domain. Only applicable when method is 'add'.

VERCEL_GET_PROJECT_DOMAIN.description: Tool to retrieve details about a specific domain attached to a Vercel project. Use when you need to check domain configuration, verification status, redirect settings, or git branch associations.

slug.description: Team slug to perform the request on behalf of

domain.description: The project domain name to retrieve (e.g., 'www.example.com')

teamId.description: Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or project name
